description: Multi-step tool-calling tasks against the real, keyless openFDA API: find drug recalls, cross-reference each recalled product's NDC to its actual manufacturer of record, and flag manufacturers with repeat recalls. Scored deterministically (repeat-entity grounding check), not by an LLM judge — the metrics that matter are tokens/cost/tool-calls/latency to a correct, grounded answer. No API key required for any tool in this suite, unlike construction_safety_agentic.json (OSHA_API_KEY).

test_cases.name: Repeat-recall manufacturer, Class I 2022-2024
test_cases.goal: Search FDA drug recalls with classification 'Class I' and report_date between 2022-01-01 and 2024-12-31. For at least 8 of the returned product_ndc codes, look up the actual manufacturer of record (labeler_name) via the NDC directory tool. Identify one manufacturer/labeler that shows up for 2 or more distinct NDCs, and name at least 2 of those NDC codes in your final answer along with the manufacturer's name. Final answer format: 'Manufacturer <labeler_name> had repeat Class I recalls across NDCs <ndc1> and <ndc2>.'

test_cases.name: Repeat-recall manufacturer, Class I 2023 H2
test_cases.goal: Search FDA drug recalls with classification 'Class I' and report_date between 2023-06-01 and 2023-12-31. For at least 8 of the returned product_ndc codes, look up the actual manufacturer of record (labeler_name) via the NDC directory tool. Identify one manufacturer/labeler that shows up for 2 or more distinct NDCs, and name at least 2 of those NDC codes in your final answer along with the manufacturer's name. Final answer format: 'Manufacturer <labeler_name> had repeat Class I recalls across NDCs <ndc1> and <ndc2>.'

test_cases.name: Recalling firm vs. true manufacturer discrepancy
test_cases.goal: Search FDA drug recalls with classification 'Class I' and report_date between 2024-01-01 and 2024-12-31. Pick the first result that has at least one product_ndc code. Look up that NDC's actual manufacturer of record (labeler_name) via the NDC directory tool, and compare it to the recall record's own recalling_firm field. End your response with exactly one final sentence, on its own line, in this exact format and nothing after it: 'For NDC <ndc>, the recalling firm was <recalling_firm> and the manufacturer of record is <labeler_name>.'
